_comment: Kagenori Tsurumine, the still crane samurai (SLICE_PLAN 3.5, kit sheet docs/heroes-v2/kits/kagenori_tsurumine.txt). The kit fields are the slice fixture's (src/test/resources/heroes/slice/kagenori_tsurumine.json); art and animations are source only (HEROES_V2 12.5, 12.6). One body for good (the owner's rule of 2026-11-13, HEROES_V2 3.6): an adult of ordinary size, standard build, drawn at 102%.
name: Kagenori Tsurumine
title: the Still Crane
description: A quiet swordsman of few words who fights like still water until the moment his blade moves.

ultimate.name: Heaven-Splitting Draw
ultimate.line: Close your eyes. It is already over.

transition.line: Then I will fight you properly.

intro.line: Tsurumine Kagenori. Draw when you are ready.

quirks: re-ties his hair before every duel

leader.title: Lord of the Still Crane
leader.motto: The blade waits. So do we.

founding: From today this land is the Still Crane's. Keep your blades clean.
last_stand: I do not turn my back. Come.

kag.iai._comment: The iai crouch: the knees bent and the weight forward, the hips turned a little to his left so the scabbard is presented, the right hand on the hilt with the blade home in the scabbard, the left hand on the scabbard's mouth, the eyes on the target.

kag.noto_m._comment: The noto (sliding the blade home), the tip at the scabbard's mouth: the blade in line with the scabbard, 10 px of it still out in front of the hip.

kag.noto_h._comment: The noto (sliding the blade home), half in: the blade in line with the scabbard, 5 px of it still out in front of the hip.

kag.draw_h._comment: Half drawn: the blade sliding out along the scabbard's line, the left hand pulling the scabbard back (saya-biki), the knees bent for the draw.

kag.iai_deep._comment: Thunderclap's stillness: the deepest crouch of the family, the hips low and the chest over the front knee, the hand on the hilt, perfectly still.

kag.iai_cut._comment: Still Water's riposte: the blade whipped out of the scabbard in one level cut to his right front, the arm straight, the hips and chest turned into it, the left hand pulling the scabbard back.

kag.iai_follow._comment: The riposte's follow-through: the blade carried on round to his right and a little back, held level (zanshin).

kag.chiburi._comment: The chiburi: the blade snapped down and out to his right, pointing forward and down, shaking it clean.

kag.tc_lunge._comment: Thunderclap Draw: the blade out of the scabbard in a lunging level draw, the arm and the blade straight out along the line at the target, the chest low over the front knee, the left hand pulling the scabbard back.

kag.c3_wind._comment: Three Cuts' compact wind-up: the blade lifted beside his right shoulder, tip up and back, the chest turned a little right, the left hand forward at the belly.

kag.c3_cut1._comment: The first cut: diagonal, down and across to the front left (kesa-giri), the chest turned left.

kag.c3_cut2._comment: The second cut: rising back across, from low left to high right (gyaku-kesa), the chest turned right.

kag.c3_load._comment: Between the second and the third cut: the blade dropped level at his right side, edge forward, the weight gathering.

kag.c3_cut3._comment: The third cut (the knockback): a level sweep from his right across to his left at chest height, the knees driving down, the chest turned left behind it.

kag.cs_coil._comment: Crane Step's wind-up: low on bent knees, the blade drawn back low at his right side pointing behind him, the left arm reaching forward like a crane's wing, the eyes on the target.

kag.cs_burst._comment: Crane Step's burst: the body thrown forward and low, the blade coming round level at his right side, the left arm swept back.

kag.cs_cut._comment: Crane Step's cut, mid-dash: the blade sweeping level across his front to the left at the waist.

kag.cs_brake._comment: Crane Step's brake: down on deep knees, the blade carried on out to his left, the chest turned left behind it.

kag.gs_raise._comment: Guard Splitter's wind-up: the blade raised high over his head, tipped back, the left hand up in front as a counterweight, the chest lifted.

kag.gs_peak._comment: Guard Splitter, the last stretch: the blade further back over the head, the body drawn up like a bow.

kag.gs_cut._comment: Guard Splitter's blow: the blade crashed straight down in front, the body folded forward over deep knees, the left hand snapped back to the hip.

kag.gs_low._comment: Guard Splitter's finish: the blade driven on down, its tip just above the ground, the weight sunk into the blow.

kag.ch_raise._comment: Chained Lightning Draw's wind-up: the blade held upright before his face, its flat toward him, the left hand's open palm raised beside it as the lightning gathers.

kag.ch_point1._comment: Chained Lightning Draw, the first strike: the arm and the blade thrust straight out at the target, the lightning leaving its point.

kag.ch_point2._comment: Chained Lightning Draw, the second jump: the point snapped to his right front.

kag.ch_point3._comment: Chained Lightning Draw, the third jump: the point swept across to his left front.

kag.fc_crouch._comment: Falling Crane's wind-up: a deep gathering crouch, the body pitched forward, both arms swept back and low like folded wings, the blade trailing behind him.

kag.fc_launch._comment: Falling Crane's launch: the legs driving straight with the toes pointed, the arms beating up and out like a crane's wings, the blade out to his right like a long feather.

kag.fc_air._comment: Falling Crane at the top: the crane in the air, arms spread wide, one knee drawn high and the other leg straight below, the chin up.

kag.fc_drop._comment: Falling Crane coming down: the blade raised over his head for the falling cut, the legs reaching for the ground.

kag.fc_land._comment: Falling Crane's landing: down blade-first on deep knees, the blade cut down in front of him, the left arm out to the side for balance.

kag.ul_sink._comment: Heaven-Splitting Draw's stillness: the deepest iai, the hips sunk low and the head bowed a little, eyes closed, the hand on the hilt.

kag.ul_rise._comment: The heaven-splitting draw: out of the scabbard in one rising cut, the body uncoiling up out of the crouch, the blade swept up past his face to point at the sky, the left hand flung back.

kag.ul_high._comment: The draw held at its height (zanshin): the blade straight up over his head, a little behind it, the body stretched tall.

kag.p2_lift._comment: Phase 2, the helmet: the left hand lifts the helmet by its brim over his head, the right hand holding the blade low at his side, the eyes forward.

kag.p2_set._comment: Phase 2, the helmet set on his head: the left hand on its brim, settling it down.

kag.p2_tie._comment: Phase 2: the left hand tugs the helmet's cord tight under his chin.

kag.p3_hilt._comment: Phase 3: the head bowed ('Forgive me, teacher.'), the blade held point down at his right side, the left hand on the short sword's hilt at his left hip.

kag.p3_draw._comment: Phase 3: the short sword drawn out to his left side in one stroke, the head up, the eyes glowing.

kag.ts_cross._comment: Twin Sky: both blades raised and crossed high before him, the long one over the short, the chin up ('Two blades.').

kag.ts_spread._comment: Twin Sky: both blades swept apart and down to his sides, the knees sinking ('No more restraint.').

kag.ls_bent._comment: The last stand: bent over and breathing hard, both blades hanging low.

kag.ls_cross._comment: The last stand: up straight, both blades crossed before his chest, the long one high ('I do not turn my back. Come.').

kag.intro_bow._comment: The intro's bow: a formal bow from the hips, the hand on the hilt of the sheathed blade, the left hand on the scabbard.

kag.intro_up._comment: The intro: upright again, the hand on the hilt ('Draw when you are ready.').

kag.rest_low._comment: The blade lowered point down at his right side, the left hand on the scabbard: the calm after the fight.

kag.rest_bow._comment: The victory's small bow toward the fallen, the blade still lowered.

kag.open_guard._comment: The taunt: no guard at all, standing tall with the blade's point lowered to the ground at his right side, the chin up.

kag.hilt_rest._comment: Personal 1: the right hand resting on the hilt of the sheathed blade at his left hip, the left hand loose at his side.

kag.breathe_in._comment: Personal 2: eyes closed, a slow deep breath in, the chest and shoulders lifting.

kag.tie_up._comment: Personal 3: both hands up behind his head at the tie of his ponytail.

kag.tie_pull._comment: Personal 3: the cord pulled tight, the hands drawn apart behind the head.

kag.iai_sink._comment: Still Water held: the iai crouch sunk a little lower over the hold, the body a degree further forward, the hand still on the hilt (only the hips, the legs and the neck move, so the blade stays home).

kag.draw_hd._comment: Thunderclap's draw starting from the deepest crouch: the blade sliding out along the scabbard's line, the hips still low.

kag.ul_drawh._comment: Heaven-Splitting Draw: from the deepest iai the blade starts out along the scabbard's line, the eyes open.

kag.p3_half._comment: Phase 3: the head comes up and the short sword starts out of its scabbard along its line.

move.three_cut.description: Three Cuts (move slot 0, a combo of 3, light: 0.45 / 0.45 / 0.35 s): no wasted motion. The blade lifts beside his right shoulder (0.2 s), a diagonal cut down and across to the front left at 0.35 s (hit, tick 9), a rising cut back across to the high right at 0.55 s (hit, tick 13), the blade dropped level at his right side as the knees load, and a level sweep from right to left at chest height at 0.75 s (the third hit and its knockback, tick 17); held a beat, and back to his guard by 1.15 s. Feet planted.

move.iai_stance.description: Still Water (move slot 1, a counter stance of 1.5 s that absorbs 80%, heavy: 1.5 / 0.1 / 0.8 s): the blade is slid home in one smooth stroke (its tip to the scabbard's mouth at 0.20 s, home at 0.30 s) and he sinks into the iai crouch, the right hand on the hilt, the left on the scabbard, the eyes on the target; the stance is the wind-up, and only his hips settle lower over it (the tell: the hand on the hilt, the server's guard click and sparks). At its end the blade slides out along the scabbard's line (1.35 s) and whips out in one level cut to his right front at 1.40 s (the riposte: hit, tick 30), cast at 1.45 s (tick 31); carried on round and held (zanshin), a chiburi flick, and back to his guard by 2.3 s. Feet planted.

move.thunderclap_draw.description: Thunderclap Draw (move slot 2, a line 8 long and 1 wide, heavy: 1.3 / 0.05 / 0.85 s): the blade slid home and the quick-draw grip set by 0.30 s (the glint), then down into his deepest crouch and total stillness; the blade starts out along the scabbard's line (1.15 s) and he lunges out in one level draw at 1.20 s (hit, tick 26: the server's thunderclap along the line), the arm and blade straight at the target; the re-sheathe (his recovery weak point): a chiburi flick, the blade slid slowly home (the sheathe sound at 1.80 s), a beat with the hand on the hilt, and a quick draw back into his guard by 2.1 s. Feet planted.

move.crane_step.description: Crane Step (move slot 3, a dash of 6, heavy: 0.8 / 0.25 / 0.8 s): down low on bent knees with the blade drawn back low at his right side, its point behind him, and the left arm reaching forward like a crane's wing (0.35-0.62 s: the tell), the burst at 0.70 s (hit, tick 16: the server carries him along the strip), the blade coming round level at the waist mid-dash, braking on deep knees with the blade carried on out to his left at 0.90 s (cast, tick 20); held, and back to his guard by 1.75 s. Feet planted (the server moves him).

move.guard_splitter.description: Guard Splitter (move slot 4, a heavy cut that breaks guard, heavy: 0.9 / 0.1 / 0.9 s): the blade raised high over his head, tipped back, the left hand up in front, the chest lifted (0.4 s), drawn further back like a bow with a held breath (0.68 s: the tell), and crashed straight down in front at 0.80 s (hit, tick 18) with a kiai, driven on down to just above the ground as the body folds over deep knees (cast, tick 19); held, and up into his guard by 1.8 s. Feet planted.

move.chain_draw.description: Chained Lightning Draw (move slot 5, a chain of 3, range 10, jump radius 4, heavy: 1.0 / 0.45 / 0.8 s): the blade raised upright before his face with its flat toward him and the left palm raised beside it while the lightning gathers and the hands tremble with it (0.45-0.85 s: the tell); the point thrust straight out at the first target at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20), snapped to his right front at 1.05 s (the second jump, tick 23) and swept across to his left front at 1.20 s (the third, tick 26), held to 1.30 s (cast, tick 28), and back to his guard by 2.15 s. Feet planted.

move.falling_crane.description: Falling Crane (move slot 6, a leap of 8 with a landing of radius 2, heavy: 0.9 / 0.5 / 1.0 s; phase 3): down into a deep gathering crouch, the body pitched forward, both arms swept back and low like folded wings with the blade trailing (0.4-0.72 s: the tell), the launch at 0.80 s (hit, tick 18) with the arms beating up and out, the crane at the top of the leap (arms spread wide, one knee drawn high, 0.95 s), the blade raised over his head as he drops (1.1 s) and the landing cut, down blade-first on deep knees at 1.25 s (cast, tick 27: the landing's knockback); held, and up into his guard by 2.3 s (Three Cuts follows).

ultimate.description: Heaven-Splitting Draw (the ultimate, a line 12 long and 2 wide, 2.0 / 0.1 / 1.6 s): the blade slid home (0.30 s), the eyes close and stay closed (no blinking) as he sinks into the deepest iai, the head bowed a little, perfectly still ('Close your eyes. It is already over.'); the eyes open sharp at 1.75 s, the blade starts out along the scabbard's line (1.85 s) and he uncoils up out of the crouch in one rising draw that sweeps the blade past his face to point at the sky at 1.90 s (hit, tick 40: the server's lightning along the line), cast at 1.95 s (tick 41); held high (zanshin) to 2.7 s, the chiburi, and back to his guard by 3.6 s. Feet planted.

state.twin_sky.description: Twin Sky (phase 3's state, played as the transition ends; two swords, attack speed +20%, damage +10%): both blades raised and crossed high before him, the long one over the short, the chin up ('Two blades.'), then swept apart and down to his sides as the knees sink ('No more restraint.'), and into his guard.

phase.2.description: Phase 2 (inside the 1.2 s transition: 'Then I will fight you properly.'): his left hand holds the plain helmet up over his head, sets it down on his head (the iron sound) and tugs its cord tight under his chin, the blade held low at his right side, and back to his guard.

phase.3.description: Phase 3 (inside the 1.4 s transition: 'Forgive me, teacher.'): the head bowed and the eyes closed, his left hand on the hilt of the short sword still in its scabbard; the head comes up, the eyes open glowing as the blades' edges light (the hum), and the short sword is drawn out to his left side in one stroke; into his guard with both blades (Twin Sky follows).

intro.description: Intro (the server holds it as long as the clip): the blade slid home (0.25 s), a formal bow from the hips with the eyes closed and the hand on the hilt ('Tsurumine Kagenori.'), upright again with the hand on the hilt and the eyes on the enemy ('Draw when you are ready.'), and the quick draw into his guard by 1.5 s. Feet planted.

victory.description: Victory ('Rest.'): the blade flicked clean in a chiburi, lowered point down at his right side, a small bow toward the fallen with the eyes closed and a low 'hm', and back to his guard.

taunt.description: Taunt: no guard at all, standing tall with the blade's point lowered to the ground at his right side and the chin up, a slow nod: come.

last_stand.description: Last stand (no action code yet: for the engine side to play under 9% of his health, HEROES_V2 6.13; 'I do not turn my back. Come.'): bent over and breathing hard with both blades hanging low, then up straight with both blades crossed before his chest, and into his guard.

personal.1.description: Idle quirk, the hilt rest: the right hand comes to rest on the hilt of the sheathed blade, the thumb nudges the guard (a soft click), the eyes half closed; the hand falls back to his side.

personal.2.description: Idle quirk, the still breath: the eyes closed, two slow deep breaths, the chest and shoulders lifting and settling.

personal.3.description: Idle quirk, re-tying the hair (he re-ties it before every duel): both hands up behind his head at the tie of his ponytail, the cord pulled tight twice, and the hands back down.
